rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya — thanks so much, great to hear from you. Right now the most useful concrete thing would be data/research work rather than outreach, since I'm still finalizing how (and whether) Halcyon Threshold shows up publicly for a few weeks yet. Two options where ~5 hrs/week would genuinely move things forward: 1) Help me scope a \"commitments tracker\" — a sourced, falsifiable record of whether frontier labs are keeping their specific, named public safety commitments (red-teaming access, external evals, incident disclosure, etc.). I'd want help finding and structuring primary sources and keeping a small dataset current. 2) Help me build a simple tracker of grant/comment/opportunity deadlines (rapid grants, public comment dockets, compute credit programs) so nothing slips. No pressure to pick right away — happy to talk it through first if you'd rather. Either way, thank you — it means a lot that the talk landed. Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (meetup volunteer) proposing two concrete ways she could help.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "weekly-opportunity-scan" (0 8 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Set up a weekly Monday scan of your inbox for new deadlines/opportunities, which will message you
